changes.title: Frame check
items: The pause page has a Frame check button (right side): it plays about a minute and a half of fixed scenes in a throwaway game on your machine (the decks, a flight over the forest, a wave fight, the treehouse, and a sail by the sea chart with its take-off), leaves your own game exactly where you paused, and shows the frame times in milliseconds with a Copy button; the last few runs are kept so you can compare before and after a release

changes.title: No landing clearance
items: Your blink and anything that throws you no longer stop short of or nudge you away from trees, rocks, soundsystems, speakers or the treehouse: you land where you're sent, and only lakes stop you

changes.title: Hare badger
items: Hares now attack with their own stamp: they bound in beside you, stamp, then sit still for a moment, which is your chance to hit them
A badger's shoulder-barge now throws you about 20 metres

changes.title: Effect marks
items: Creatures no longer stun her: an attack that used to freeze her for a moment (the lynx's pounce, the ram's headbutt, the lion's roar, the sphinx's gaze) now slows her to less than half speed for three times as long, with stars circling her head

You can now see what's been done to her: while she's slowed, stars circle her head and her steps drag; while she's confused, a spiral turns over her head; thrown hard, she skids in a trail of dust. She's tinted with the attacker's colour and each has its own sound
Each attack's warning shape on the ground is now in its attacker's own colour (green for venom, amber for earth, icy blue for frost...) instead of all red, as a trial

changes.title: Treetop sigils
items: From the treetops, your placed sigils now show clearly above the trees in their full colour, each with a visible column of light down to its spot

changes.title: Edge fade
items: The grass at the edge of her light no longer shimmers as she walks: its fade stays put on each tuft
On a slower machine, far trees and decor fade out and back in gently instead of popping when the frame rate dips
String lights at the far edge go out bulb by bulb, not a whole string at once

changes.title: Soundsystem 150
items: Soundsystems and home's speakers have much less health (150 each, from 500), so a siege you're losing is over quickly instead of dragging on
